note: Frozen terms for candidate-versus-incumbent evaluations. A registration is written BEFORE its evaluation window opens; one written afterwards is marked PRIOR_OBSERVATION and can never earn a promotion, however good its numbers are. Promotion is a governed act performed by a person against the readout — nothing in this repository promotes a model.

registrations.why: The isotonic calibrator was already fitted and scored on this window before these terms were written down. Recording it as a preregistration would be choosing the terms to fit a result that was already known, which is the exact dishonesty the mechanism exists to prevent. It is kept as the baseline observation the next window will be measured against.
